_note: Policy for scripts/test-changed.mjs (the CHECK_FAST_CMD router, bead web-ai-showcase-360 / ADR web-ai-showcase-cxw). Every key is optional; the router is fail-closed without this file (fallback = the whole unit suite, nothing deferred). The 'heavy' list is a MEASURED, REVERSIBLE policy owned by bead web-ai-showcase-ehf: those tests are still routed and reported ('fast-gate: deferred-heavy: ...') but the fast tier does not run them; the merger's full gate and the scheduled heavy tier do. Remove an entry the moment that test stops being slow.

_browserNote: Every changed path matching these globs is reported as BROWSER_UNVERIFIED with the jdz blocker on the same line, and stays routed normally (so an unmapped browser-facing path still reaches the fallback). Extend this list when a new browser-only surface lands; it is a report, never a coverage claim.
_mapNote: Explicit entries for paths no dependency walk can resolve. route-download-inventory.mjs is driven by its suite through a shell command (execSync), which is not an import: the AST index cannot see the edge, so without this entry a scanner-only change falls closed to the widened set and the external coverage reporter warns that the path is unmapped (bead web-ai-showcase-wkf7, observed on three gate runs for iem2). test/route-inventory-scanner.test.mjs drives the script directly (16 cases, 1.5s measured 2026-10-12). test/download-inventory.test.mjs is deliberately NOT listed: it validates the artifact the scanner GENERATES (download-routes.json), not the script, and any change that touches that artifact already routes it through the normal dependency graph.
